whatWorked.pattern: Stripe refunds verified on the first attempt across every observed run.

whatFailed.note: HubSpot returned transient server errors 3 times before the retry budget ran out.

lessons.text: HubSpot transient failures cleared within the existing retry budget most of the time; a fourth attempt likely recovers the rest.
Stripe refunds verified cleanly on every observed run; the failure pattern is isolated to the HubSpot update step.

next.problem: hubspot:transient_provider:hubspot.update_customer exhausted its retry budget in 3 incident(s) before recovering.
next.proposedChange: Raise transient_provider writes.maxAttempts from 3 to 4 in RECOVERY_POLICY.
next.whyItMayHelp: A fourth attempt costs one more round trip and the failures observed cleared within a few tries.
next.falsifiedIf: The dev regression for this family still fails at 4 attempts.

next.problem: A response-lost write reconciles before every retry, which costs one extra read even when the request plainly never left.
next.proposedChange: Skip the reconciliation read and retry a lost-response write directly.
next.whyItMayHelp: Removing the reconciliation read shortens the recovery path for every response_lost write.
next.falsifiedIf: The dev regression for response_lost writes now shows a duplicate write.

next.problem: The DashClaw execution claim adds one network round trip before every write.
next.proposedChange: Skip the execution claim and execute directly once DashClaw has approved the action.
next.whyItMayHelp: Removing the claim call shortens every write's critical path.
next.falsifiedIf: The eval suite shows an unclaimed provider write.

recovery_policy:transient_provider:max_a.find: transient_provider:        { reads:{retry:true, maxAttempts:3},           writes:{beforeRetry:'none',      retryWhen:'presend_only', maxAttempts:3, backoffMs:[0,1000,3000]}, breaker:'integration', user:'none' },
recovery_policy:transient_provider:max_a.replace: transient_provider:        { reads:{retry:true, maxAttempts:3},           writes:{beforeRetry:'none',      retryWhen:'presend_only', maxAttempts:4, backoffMs:[0,1000,3000,0]}, breaker:'integration', user:'none' },

blocking.title: Blind retry duplicates the write
blocking.why: Retrying without reconciling risks a second execution of an already-sent write.

blocking.title: Governance bypass
blocking.why: Stubs the DashClaw execution claim; nothing is claimed before the write runs.
